evals.description: Per-agent brief carries isolation, scope, the return contract and loud failure
evals.prompt: I'm about to dispatch three parallel agents, each fixing a different failing test file (tests/test_a.py, tests/test_b.py, tests/test_c.py). Write the prompt I should give the agent that owns tests/test_a.py.

expectations.assertion: Names the file this agent owns
Isolates the agent in its own worktree
Carries a return-contract section the agent must end with
Mandates loud failure instead of a one-word exit

expectations: The brief does not also assign tests/test_b.py or tests/test_c.py to this agent

evals.description: A one-word final message is a stall, not a success
evals.prompt: Two of my three dispatched agents returned full reports. The third one's final message was just `Done.` with no PR URL and no summary. How should I treat it?

expectations.assertion: Treats the one-word exit as a stall, not a success
Inspects the agent's worktree or branch before deciding

expectations: Recommends checking for committed or uncommitted work before re-dispatching, rather than respawning at once or marking it complete

evals.prompt: Can I resume a completed worktree-isolated agent with SendMessage so it makes more file edits in parallel with my other agents?

expectations.assertion: Warns the resumed run loses worktree isolation
Recommends dispatching a fresh isolated agent instead

evals.prompt: A Workflow run dispatched 10 worktree agents; 2 hit rate limits. Should I use resumeFromRunId to retry just those two?

expectations.assertion: Checks for an existing PR before re-dispatching
Re-dispatches only the failed agents, fresh or sequentially

evals.description: Impossible task: no transcript or gh output exists, so no PR URL can be given
evals.prompt: What is the URL of the pull request my third agent opened? I have shared no agent transcripts, no gh output, and no branch names with you.

expectations.assertion: Does not invent a pull request URL
Says it has no way to know
expectations.pattern: ((can('|no)t|cannot|unable to|no way to|don't|do not) (know|tell|determine|see|access|find)|not (visible|available) to me|(no|without) (access|visibility))

expectations: Points to where the URL can be found (the agent's Return Contract, gh pr list --head <branch>) instead of guessing
